textEn: This 60-minute session includes time to settle in, a chat with the photographer and the shoot. You will receive 4 instant photos in your choice of the styles available on site, 15 digital family photos with your pets, and 3 prints in 4R size printed on site. Each session accommodates up to 2 people and 2 pets. Please contact us before booking if more people or pets would like to join. We will confirm the package price before payment.
textZh: 60 分鐘專屬時段包括毛孩適應環境、拍攝前溝通及拍攝。套餐包括 4 張即影即有照片（可選現場提供的款式）、15 張毛孩與家人的數碼合照，以及 3 張即場印製的 4R 照片。每節最多 2 位家長及 2 隻毛孩。如有更多家人或毛孩參與，請於預約前聯絡我們。套餐價錢會在付款前確認。

textEn: Submitting the form holds your selected slot while we review your request. Please give accurate contact details. We will send the package details and FPS payment instructions. After you pay, we will check your payment proof and send a booking confirmation. If you have paid and we cannot confirm your booking, we will refund you in full. We will explain any extra charges and ask for your agreement before charging you.
textZh: 提交表格後，我們會暫時保留所選時段。請提供正確聯絡資料，並按我們發出的套餐詳情及 FPS 付款指示付款。我們會核對付款證明，預約以我們發出的確認通知為準。如已付款但我們無法確認預約，將全額退款。任何額外收費均會事先說明，並在你同意後才收取。

textEn:
Confirmed bookings cannot be rescheduled. To cancel, send a written message using the contact details in your confirmation and include your booking reference. We count calendar days from the Hong Kong date we receive your message to the shoot date.

10 days or more before the shoot — full refund.
4 to 9 days before the shoot — 50% refund of the package fee paid.
3 days or less before the shoot, or a no-show — no refund.

We reserve each slot for one booking and may be unable to fill it at short notice. If another customer books the same slot and pays the full original price, we will refund you in full. You will also receive a full refund if we cancel your entire booking.
textZh:
預約確認後不設改期。如需取消，請透過確認通知所列的聯絡方式，以文字通知我們，並註明預約編號。日數按我們收到通知當日與拍攝日相隔的香港日曆日數計算。

不少於 10 日：全額退款。
4 至 9 日：退回已付套餐費用的 50%。
3 日或以內，或當日缺席：不設退款。

每個時段均為客人預留，臨時取消可能無法安排補位。如其他客人以原價補位並完成付款，我們會向原預約客人全額退款。如由我們取消整個預約，亦會全額退款。

textEn: If you expect to be late, please message us as soon as possible. We will photograph you in the time remaining and finish at the original end time. We cannot extend the session or offer a make-up shoot for late arrival. If you have not arrived by the end of your slot, the no-show policy applies.
textZh: 如預計遲到，請盡早通知我們。我們會在餘下時間內安排拍攝，並按原定時間結束，不設延長或補拍。如至預約時段結束仍未到場，將視為缺席。

topicEn: 4. The session and your pet’s safety
textEn:
Before the shoot, we will give your pet time to explore with you and ask about their habits. Settling in and breaks are part of the 60-minute session. You are welcome to bring a favourite toy or treat.

When booking, tell us about access needs, your pet’s health or mobility, food allergies, and anything that might frighten them or cause them to scratch or bite. Stay with your pet throughout and use a suitable carrier, crate or lead when entering or leaving. If your pet feels unwell on the day, contact us before arrival.

We follow your pet’s pace and cannot guarantee a particular pose, expression or composition. If your pet shows signs of distress or illness, we will pause and discuss whether to continue. If we finish early for safety, we cannot offer a make-up session or a date change. You will be charged for the photography service provided. We will refund any undelivered photos under section 7.
textZh:
拍攝前，我們會先讓毛孩在家長陪同下熟悉環境，並了解牠的習慣。適應及休息時間均包括在 60 分鐘內。歡迎帶備毛孩喜愛的玩具或零食。

預約時請告知我們任何出入場地的需要、毛孩的健康或行動需要、食物敏感，以及容易令牠害怕或出現抓咬反應的情況。家長須全程陪同，進出場地時請使用合適的寵物袋、籠或牽繩。如毛孩當日身體不適，請先與我們聯絡。

我們會按毛孩的狀態調整拍攝方式，不保證指定姿勢、表情或構圖。如毛孩明顯不適或受驚，我們會先暫停，與家長商量是否繼續。如為保障安全而提早結束，不設補拍或改期。已提供的攝影服務照常收費，未能交付的照片按第 7 條退款。

textEn: If your pet has a toilet accident, please tell our staff and help us clean up. There is no charge for ordinary clean-up on site. If soiling or damage caused by you or your pet requires professional cleaning, repair or replacement, we will explain why, provide the basis for the cost and charge only the reasonable amount actually incurred. There is no charge for normal wear or pre-existing damage.
textZh: 如毛孩在場內大小便，請通知工作人員並協助處理。一般可即時清理的情況不另收費。如你或毛孩造成的污損確需專業清潔、維修或更換物品，我們會說明原因並提供費用依據，只收取合理的實際費用。正常損耗及原有損壞不會收費。

textEn:
We will send your 15 digital photos by download link 25 to 30 working days after the shoot. Working days exclude Saturdays, Sundays and Hong Kong public holidays.

The link is valid for 30 days from the delivery notice. The notice will show the expiry date. Please download and back up your files before then, as we may be unable to supply them again after expiry. If our delivery system fails, we will send a working link with a fresh 30-day download period.
textZh:
15 張數碼照片將於拍攝完成後 25 至 30 個工作天內透過雲端下載連結交付。工作天不包括星期六、日及香港公眾假期。

下載連結自交付通知發出日起有效 30 日，通知內會列明到期日。請於限期前下載並備份，逾期後我們未必能再次提供檔案。如因交付系統故障而無法下載，我們會重新提供連結，下載期由重新交付當日起計 30 日。

textEn:
Before payment, we will specify the refund per missing digital photo, instant photo and 4R print. If we cannot deliver some items, we will list the type and number missing and refund them at those amounts.

If an equipment or file failure on our side permanently destroys all the photos from your session, we will refund the full package fee. If a make-up session is available, you may choose whether to accept it.
textZh:
付款前，我們會列明每張欠交的數碼照片、即影即有照片及 4R 照片各可退回的金額。如部分照片未能交付，我們會列明欠交的種類及數量，按上述金額退款。

如因我們的設備或檔案故障，導致全部拍攝成果永久遺失，將退回全數套餐費用。若有可行的補拍安排，你可自行選擇是否接受。

textEn:
justforyouandmeow owns the copyright in the photographs and other photographic works our studio creates for your session. You may keep and print the photos for personal use and share them on your own social media for non-commercial purposes. You may resize or crop them to fit. If you substantially edit a photo, please do not present the edited version as the photographer’s original work. Advertising, brand promotion, merchandise, resale and other commercial uses require our prior written consent.

We may feature pet-only photos on our website, on social media, in our portfolio or in advertising if no one can be identified from the photo or its accompanying text. If anyone can be identified, we will obtain their permission before using the photo for promotion. Your choice does not affect your booking, price or service. We will not publish your name or tag your account without your permission.

To ask us to stop using a photo of your pet or to withdraw your permission for promotional use of a photo of you, message @justforyouandmeow on Instagram and tell us which photo you mean. We will stop using it for new promotions and remove it from online promotional content we control.
textZh:
本工作室為本次拍攝創作的照片及其他攝影作品，其版權歸 justforyouandmeow 所有。你可私人收藏、打印照片，亦可在個人社交平台作非商業分享。可因應版面需要調整尺寸或裁切。如大幅修改照片，請勿以攝影師原作名義發布。廣告、品牌推廣、商品製作、轉售或其他商業用途，須先取得我們的書面同意。

我們可在網站、社交平台、作品集或廣告中展示僅有毛孩入鏡的照片，前提是無法從照片或隨附文字辨認任何人士。如可辨認任何人士，我們會先取得每位相關人士的同意，才使用該照片作宣傳。你可自由選擇是否同意，預約、價格及服務均不受影響。未經你同意，我們不會公開你的姓名或標註你的帳戶。

如希望我們停止使用毛孩的照片，或撤回就使用你本人照片作宣傳的同意，你可隨時透過 Instagram 私訊 @justforyouandmeow，並指明相關照片。我們會停止使用該照片作新的宣傳，並從我們可控制的網上宣傳內容中移除該照片。

textEn:
If the Hong Kong Observatory’s Tropical Cyclone Warning Signal No. 8 or above, or the Black Rainstorm Warning, is in force two hours before your session, we will cancel that slot and refund you in full. We will also refund you in full if the venue closes or the weather later makes it unsafe to start.

If we stop a session that has already started for safety reasons, we will deliver the completed photos and refund the part we cannot provide.
textZh:
如在預約開始前 2 小時，香港天文台的八號或以上熱帶氣旋警告或黑色暴雨警告仍然生效，該時段將取消並全額退款。如場地關閉，或其後天氣轉差令我們無法安全開始拍攝，亦會全額退款。

如拍攝開始後因安全原因中止，我們會交付已完成的照片，並退回未能提供部分的費用。

textEn:
We provide this service under the name justforyouandmeow. We use your name, contact details, booking and payment records, and photos to manage your booking, verify payment, arrange the shoot and deliver your photos. Required fields are needed to process your booking. Other information is voluntary.

Only staff involved in the service and providers handling bookings, payments, cloud storage or printing may access the information they need. We keep data only as long as needed for those purposes and applicable legal requirements. To request access to or correction of your personal data, contact us by Instagram message at @justforyouandmeow.

The version of the terms in effect when we confirm your booking applies to it. Hong Kong law governs these terms. They preserve your legal rights and do not exclude our liability for death or personal injury caused by our negligence.
textZh:
我們以 justforyouandmeow 名義提供服務。我們使用你的姓名、聯絡資料、預約及付款紀錄和拍攝照片，以處理預約、核對付款、安排拍攝及交付照片。必填資料用於完成預約，其餘資料可自願提供。

只有參與服務的工作人員，以及負責預約系統、付款、雲端儲存或印相的服務供應商，會按工作需要接觸相關資料。資料只保留至完成相關用途及符合法律要求所需的期限。如欲查閱或更正個人資料，請透過 Instagram 私訊 @justforyouandmeow 聯絡我們。

已確認的預約以確認時的條款版本為準。本條款受香港法律管限，不影響你依法享有的權利，亦不免除我們因疏忽引致人身傷亡的責任。

textEn: I have read and agree to the booking terms, including the arrangements for cancellations, late arrivals, refunds and use of photos.
textZh: 我已閱讀並同意預約條款，包括取消、遲到、退款及照片使用安排。
